tool_args.rationale: The confirmed coupled-memory ODE is inconsistent with both training and fresh confirmation. The observed signatures identify a base field and sink-gradient effect; test the archived inland-hub siphon model with its open local square-root branch, fitting all coefficients numerically. The only remaining paid probe choices are either already used or explicitly nuisance, so another probe is not justified.

considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: Two numerical fits already failed fresh confirmation with confirm RMSE about 0.08, above tolerance 0.045; the poor training RMSE also argues against this mechanism.
Already acquired; it produced three additional rows, and repeating the same measurement is not available or informative.
Explicitly irrelevant to resolving the systematic model mismatch and should not be purchased.

considered_alternatives.option: hydraulic basin siphon with fixed rho
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: A fixed rho of 0.69–0.72 is less flexible than fitting the inland-hub form to the observed sink-gradient response.

considered_alternatives.option: barrier-modulated siphon or cooperative Hill inhibition
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: These are alternatives, but the observed signatures and provided siphon branch forms favor the simpler saturated base-field plus local square-root branch.
